title: Path
description: A single self-contained historical playthrough. See GAME_DESIGN.md for authoring rules.

$schema.description: Not used by the game — allowed so editors can point here for IntelliSense.

id.description: Stable snake_case identifier, unique across all paths.

title.description: Player-facing path title, e.g. 'The Exam Candidate'.

era.description: Free-text period/place label, e.g. 'Song Dynasty China, 1057'.

cover.description: Optional image key for the path's card art. The game loads game/assets/img/<pathId>/<cover>.(webp|jpg|png) and shows a flat placeholder if the file is missing.

bio.description: Optional 1-2 sentence flavor bio shown at path start.

trueIdentity.description: Author-facing only. If this path uses a hidden-identity twist (see GAME_DESIGN.md §5a), the historical figure the protagonist secretly is/becomes. Never shown to the player directly — only surfaced via a node's `revealedIdentity` at the twist ending. The player MUST NOT render this field.

startingHearts.description: Hearts at path start. Default convention: 5.

maxHearts.description: Cap hearts can be healed to via positive deltas. Not schema-enforced: startingHearts should be <= maxHearts.

startNode.description: Key into `nodes` where the path begins. Not schema-enforced: must exist in `nodes` and must not be an ending.

heartsDepletedNode.description: Key into `nodes` the engine routes to the instant hearts reach 0, overriding whatever `next` the triggering choice named. Not schema-enforced: must exist in `nodes`, must be `ending: true` with `endingType: "death"`. This node is reached structurally (via the hearts mechanism), never via a choice's `next` — validators must treat both `startNode` and `heartsDepletedNode` as reachability roots, or every path will wrongly report this node as unreachable.

nodes.description: Map of nodeId -> Node. Every `next` referenced by a choice must exist as a key here.

propertyNames.description: Also avoid `__proto__`, `constructor`, `prototype` — not expressible here, enforced by the player's validator.

text.description: 1-4 short lines of narration for this beat.

age.description: Optional, display only: the character's age during this beat, shown in the HUD ('Age 12') and as 'Lived to' on the ending screen. Carries over to later nodes that don't set one. Not a game variable (see GAME_DESIGN.md §9).

image.description: Optional scene image key (game/assets/img/<pathId>/<image>.*). Carries over to later nodes that don't set one.

title.description: Short name of an ending for the endings gallery, e.g. 'Eaten by Ammit'. Only valid on ending nodes.

ending.description: True if this node has no choices and terminates the path. Required (not defaulted) so a bare node object can't validate ambiguously.

endingType.description: Required when ending is true; forbidden otherwise.

twist.description: True if this ending includes a hidden-identity reveal payoff (see GAME_DESIGN.md §5a). Only valid on ending nodes; use on at most one or two endings per path, sparingly across the whole path catalog.

revealedIdentity.description: Required when twist is true; forbidden otherwise. The reveal text/name shown to the player at this ending, e.g. 'You were Alexander Pope — and this time, you lived.' Shown only after the player taps past the ending text (see player.html) — never simultaneously with it.

choices.description: Exactly 2 choices. Required on non-ending nodes; forbidden on ending nodes.

id.description: Choice id, unique within its node (commonly 'a' / 'b').

text.description: 2-6 word player-facing choice label. Must not telegraph safe/risky — see GAME_DESIGN.md §4.

next.description: Target nodeId. Not schema-enforced: must exist in `nodes`.

consequence.description: Optional one-line aftermath of THIS choice, rendered above the destination node's text when the player arrives via this edge (including when hearts-depletion redirects the arrival). Lives on the choice, not the node, because a reconverged-upon node has a different consequence per incoming edge. Never states a heart number — the meter moves silently per GAME_DESIGN.md §3.

heartsDelta.description: Most choices omit this (0). Negative = damage, rare small positive = relief. Not shown in narration text. Forbidden together with `fatal`.

fatal.description: If true, this choice routes to `next` (which must be an ending node with endingType "death") and skips all heart arithmetic entirely — the meter does not move. Mutually exclusive with `heartsDelta`. Use at most once per path, for a genuinely reckless/absurd option.
